nataliaPatch.description: Metadata-only authenticated input claim immediately before the existing pane write path, over a Unix domain socket on POSIX hosts and a named pipe on Windows.
nataliaPatch.windowsBehaviour: The claim is enforced on Windows through a named pipe client. The exchange runs on a worker thread under a single deadline because a pipe handle offers no per-operation timeout.

build.command: npm run native-terminal:build-wezterm (cleans Conda variables, sets PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, and uses /usr/bin/gcc and /usr/bin/g++)
build.windowsCrossCommand: npm run native-terminal:build-wezterm:windows-cross (rebuilds the environment to exclude an activated Conda toolchain, targets x86_64-pc-windows-gnu through mingw64, provides the MSVC-style OpenSSL library names that libssh-rs-sys requests, and stages the executables in target/release)
build.windowsNativeCommand: npm run native-terminal:build-wezterm:windows (run on a Windows host with rustup and the MSVC build tools)
build.windowsRuntimeDependencies: System DLLs only; no mingw runtime redistributable is required.
